pixelFacts.composition: One unframed black-on-white graph; no subfigures, panels, table, lattice, legend, shaded region, apparatus or cultural illustration.
pixelFacts.axes: Vertical axis m with upward arrow, horizontal axis v with rightward arrow. They intersect near source pixel (100, 515). Both extend a little past the origin in the negative directions. Origin is labeled O below and left; no separate visible point marker.
pixelFacts.massScale: Eight left-side tick marks labeled m_0, 2m_0, 3m_0, 4m_0, 5m_0, 6m_0, 7m_0, 8m_0 in increasing order. m_0 is above the horizontal axis. No label 0 on the mass axis, and no infinity label.
pixelFacts.speedScale: Nine interior short ticks between the origin and c, counting the longer midpoint tick labeled 0.5c. The other eight interior ticks are unlabeled. c is printed below the vertical limit stroke at the right of the plotted domain. The horizontal axis continues beyond c to its arrow and v label. There are no labeled velocities above c, no negative-speed labels, and no decimal labels on the other ticks.
pixelFacts.limitStroke: A distinct SOLID near-vertical black stroke rises from the horizontal axis at c to approximately the top of the drawn curve. It is not dashed. Source pixels do not label it as a second data curve or specify a finite mass at c.
pixelFacts.curve: Exactly one SOLID continuous rising curve. Its left endpoint coincides with the mass-axis m_0 tick at v=0. It is nearly horizontal initially, rises gradually, then steepens sharply just to the left of c. The visible upper truncation is a little above the 8m_0 tick, approximately 8.4m_0 by the hand-drawn scale. This estimate is NOT a printed given value or an exact queried ordinate. There is no point marker at that truncation and no curve at or to the right of c.
pixelFacts.notPresent: No equation inside the source image, no gamma label, no accelerator numerical examples, no queried sample coordinates, no maxima/minima markers, no arrows on the curve, and no rest-mass comparison line.

inventory.description: One shared m-versus-v frame, upward/rightward arrows, origin O below-left. No source point dots, grid, table or separate subfigures.

Eight mass ticks, at m_0 through 8m_0, above the horizontal origin. Preserve all eight exact labels and their order. Uniform spacing is the modern regularization of the source's slightly uneven printing.
Nine interior speed ticks with only the midpoint labeled 0.5c; c at the limit stroke. Tenth-step coordinates regularize the pixels and do not introduce eight new printed values.

Preserve the source's distinct solid vertical stroke at c, from the speed axis to the upper plot. Thin muted styling differentiates this boundary from the data curve; dashed styling would misstate the source.

One solid increasing curve starts at (v=0,m=m_0), lies left of c, and truncates slightly above 8m_0. No finite point at c. Exact analytic curvature follows authoritative equation (8.9), not hand-drawn sample estimates. No source exercise queries exact sampled coordinates.

modernRegularization.upperTruncation: Use m/m_0=8.4 solely as an unlabeled drawing cutoff just above the final source tick, not as a printed given or a finite maximum.
modernRegularization.noErrataGraphPoints: Neither p0266-math-1 nor p0266-math-2 changes the graph definition. Do not add the 100x or 2000x accelerator examples.
